The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "long double __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, long double arg3 @ st0, int32_t arg4 @ 0xc, int32_t arg5 @ 0x10, int32_t arg6 @ 0x14, int32_t arg7 @ 0x18)" at 0x004A9C40; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a9c40 (int32_t arg_8h, int32_t arg_10h, int32_t arg_14h, int32_t arg_18h, int32_t arg_1ch);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A9C40 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame.
